citations.assessment: The literal Shimon heading sends the reader onward to Shemuel. The latter notice objects to the Yishmael form and supplies witnesses; avoid merging their identities.

holds.reason: The reciprocal points to Yuḥasin under Yod, and connects its report to the Vayikra Rabbah variant. The precise Yuḥasin text still needs independent collation.
